prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE high-definition production 2D game-character sprite, single unified base for later animation, not a sprite sheet.
Create a newly rendered, genuinely high-detail mature male village leader for the Earth-era human martial outpost in the Chinese science-fiction world of Swallowed Star (吞噬星空). This is a pure 2D painted raster sprite.

INPUT ROLES (strictly separate):
Image 1, frame-125.png: the authoritative ORIGINAL CHIEF pose and projected body silhouette. Closely preserve its fixed elevated near-front game camera, sturdy broad shoulder-to-coat proportions, visible crown/top of head, downward-facing head angle, arms lowered at the same outward spacing, relaxed hands at the same relative heights, long-clothing envelope and two planted visible feet with the same relative separation. The checker/dither shape extending to image-right is an obsolete ground shadow, NOT anatomy or costume; do not reproduce it. Redesign clothing and detail, not the pose.
Image 2, earth-hero-S-idle-phase17.png: same-project surface quality, realistic material separation, warm upper-left daylight and soft cool ambient fill ONLY. Do not borrow this younger hero's face, narrow athletic proportions, standing pose, short jacket, red shoulders, chest armor, equipment or foot arrangement.

CHARACTER AND CLOTHING:
A mature, sturdy, broad-built human man approximately middle-aged, with short dark hair and a clean-shaven or very lightly stubbled experienced face; no elderly appearance. Modern practical high stand collar, fully closed neckline, a plainly readable straight central ZIPPER. A long work coat of MATTE brown-gray dense woven technical FABRIC, with convincing weight, structured seams, heavy but natural sleeves and a long workwear hem. The fabric must visibly read as cloth rather than shiny leather. Only a few restrained small lightweight segmented armor accents, without a dominant chest plate or armored skirt. Dark practical boots. Both arms naturally hang at the sides with both hands empty, loosely curled and relaxed. Preserve source 1's broad compact projected silhouette instead of turning him into a long slender hero. No weapon, staff, carried object or new equipment.

VIEW AND RENDER:
Faithfully retain source 1's elevated fixed game angle and its frontal facing; the top of the head and shoulders are clearly visible from above. No cinematic eye-level view, no camera rotation, no raised chin, no walking step, no altered foot spacing. Realistic high-detail 2D painted rendering and clean edges, in the same Earth-era art family as image 2. Strong readable form, restrained weathering, subtle woven fabric grain, coherent collar, zipper, seams, elbow joints, fingers and boots. Warm upper-left daylight with soft cool fill; character self-shading only. No glowing contour or painted cast shadow. Preserve natural source asymmetry; do not mirror or force bilateral symmetry.

OUTPUT:
Exactly ONE character in ONE pose, isolated on a truly transparent background. Square high-resolution canvas, preferably 1536 by 1536 or larger. Whole head through BOTH complete boots visible with safe transparent margins. Make the actual visible body 1000–1300 pixels tall if possible, and in any case more than 800 pixels; fill about 85% of the canvas height. Generate genuine new detail, never upscale or retain the source's pixel blocks. Do not let empty canvas substitute for subject resolution. No labels, text, numbers, guides, arrows, background, ground, pedestal, checkerboard, contact ellipse, cast shadow, multi-view sheet or additional figure.

EXCLUDE:
White-haired or white-bearded old man, long beard, monk, Taoist, traditional robe, leather robe, V-neck, crossed wrap neckline, laces or winding chest straps, traditional lamellar apron, cape, giant pauldrons, glowing armor, excessive silver chest-to-knee armor, red shoulder plates, copied hero identity, deformed hands, extra fingers or limbs, cropped feet.

This one image is a review CANDIDATE only. Do not produce animation frames.
